# Candle: a brass dish 0.6 m across with a cup, a wax candle 0.5 m tall (top at 0.66). Origin on the
# bench under its centre. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Brass --base-color 0.7137 0.5137 0.2980 --no-slot
material new Wax --base-color 0.9294 0.9020 0.7961 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Dish --vertices 12 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 0.025
add mesh cylinder --name Cup --vertices 8 --radius 0.155 --depth 0.11 --location 0 0 0.105
add mesh torus --name Loop --major-segments 8 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.09 --minor-radius 0.035 --location 0.36 0 0.05
select Dish Cup Loop
material assign Brass
add mesh cylinder --name Wax --vertices 8 --radius 0.12 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.41 --rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Wax
add mesh cube --name Drip --size 1 --location 0.1 -0.06 0.55
scale 0.06 0.06 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Wax
select Dish
active Dish
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Cup
active Cup
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Wax
active Wax
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Dish Cup Loop Wax Drip
active Dish
join
rename Dish Candle
shade flat
export candle.glb
